plain: Telling one thing apart from another

webster.text: Separating; distinguishing; marking with notes of difference.

example.quote: But, sir, where is the necessity of discriminating between the three cases of chancery, admiralty, and common lawf Why not leave it to Congress ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
